text:
kim (People Ops): Heads-up: incoming candidate is flying from London and requested an official invitation letter for US entry (B-1) and temporary laptop import paperwork. Can we confirm what we provide? cc @eric @priya @legal
eric (Recruiter): Candidate prefers an in-person loop but needs the letter for visa appointment. Also asked if spouse can attend airport pickup.
priya (Hiring Manager): We can do the in-person loop on Tue. I prefer not to have spouse sit in interviews but happy to meet briefly in lobby.
legal (Legal): We can issue an invitation letter for visa/interview purposes. Need full legal name, passport number, travel dates. We don't "sponsor" B visas but provide supporting docs. I'll draft a template.
kim (People Ops): Action: Eric to collect passport num + travel dates. Legal will produce pdf letter. Also: IT note 1 candidate needs a loaner dev laptop temporarily shipped (for secure pairing) 1 customs/export form required. @it-support-bot can help with shipping and MDM.
it-support-bot: Ticket IT-8812 created: temporary loaner shipping + MDM image. Please fill form: https://internal.redwood/equipment/temp-export. We'll include a pre-filled customs affidavit.
priya (Hiring Manager): For pairing, prefer candidate gets the loaner for 48h before on-site to run GPU test. Can we expedite shipping?
kim (People Ops): We have express ship budget up to $120 for candidate-facing equipment. Expense code for export shipping: "intl-equip-2167". Per diem note: meals covered up to $60/day while on-site; lodging capped at $275/night.
eric (Recruiter): Confirmed candidate ok with loaner. I'll collect passport info and spouse arrival details. Also candidate requests evening check-in after 9pm local time 1 can we offer late check-in and rideshare?
kim (People Ops): Late check-in ok; we'll book hotel with 24hr desk. Rideshare up to $90 after 8pm. Use code "candidate-intl-2167". I'll add calendar note: "Candidate requires invitation letter and temporary equipment export paperwork".
security-bot: Pre-registration link: https://badge.redwood.example/visitor?ref=2167004321. Added note: spouse escort allowed in lobby only.
legal (Legal): Drafted invite letter and export affidavit. Eric please confirm passport info so I can sign. I'll attach PDF to thread once signed.
eric (Recruiter): Got it. Sending passport info now via secure form. Will share travel itinerary and spouse note.
kim (People Ops): Closing: legal letter pending passport, IT ticket created, hotel & rideshare budget approved. If anything changes ping me. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
